intro_q: You work for the Career Services Office and have invited a guest speaker to speak to students. Write an email to them.
bullet1_q: Describe the speaker and why you invited them.
bullet2_q: Explain how the talk fits students’ interests.
bullet3_q: Provide date, time, and location details

sample.bullet1: We have invited Dr. Laura Kim, a senior marketing strategist with over ten years of experience to give a lecture on modern marketing. We selected her because she is a renowned expert in digital marketing and one of our alumni.
sample.bullet2: It would be a valuable opportunity for students to connect classroom learning with real-world applications through Dr. Kim's case studies. The speaker will also share interview tips for students who wish to enter the industry in the near future.
sample.bullet3: The event will take place on Tuesday at 6:00 p.m. in Room 204 of the main building. If you have any questions about the session, please feel free to contact me.
sample.closing:
We look forward to seeing you at the event.

Kind regards,
Department of Business Administration
sample.bullet2_variety:
1: Extraposition (It is adj. to…)
2: Relative clause (…, which …)
sample.bullet3_variety:
1. [Event] will take place on [date] at [time] in [location].
2: Fronted subordinate clause (If….,...)
